title: Artifact Standard Subsets Real Vocabularies
description: Refactor the degenerate artifact standard subsets mechanism (85 of 86 subset dirs are still ✳️any; the one real pilot PDF/A-2b conflates family with conformance level) into real industry subset vocabularies end to end for every stdio standard: pdf (a/x on 1.4; a/x/e/ua/vt/h on 1.7), step ap214 (cc1-cc6), a new ifc 2x3 standard (cv20/sav/cobie) plus ifc 4 (rv/dtv), svg 1.1 (tiny/basic), ecma-376 docx/xlsx/pptx (strict/transitional), json (i-json), zip (iso21320), xml (valid), tiff (baseline), jpg (baseline). Each real subset gets a spec-derived conformance analyzer, registered SubsetValidator, composer write-support, and inline tests, following the existing PDF/A-2b pattern. Mechanism layer: a per-standard 🔣️component.json subset vocabulary manifest as SSOT, taxonomy.json subsetDirPrefix/subsetSlugPattern, io/component.rs SubsetId/run_subset_validation refactor, and a script.ts policy overhaul (kill the ✳️any hard-filter, replace hardcoded allowlists with a structural schema-owning/delegating rule, add policyStandardSubsetVocabularyBreaches). Executed via a large parallel-agent workforce (Workflow tool), one agent per artifact, orchestrator-only edits to shared files (glue.rs/script.ts/taxonomy.json/io component.rs). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-artifact-standard-subsets-prancy-snowflake.md. Related to but scoped separately from ticket 26/08/10/ARTIFACT-SYSTEM-OVERHAUL-REAL-CODECS-RUNTIME-REUSE-EVOLUTION (its D5/D6 items), which is a large multi-session ticket with other waves (F1-F6) actively claiming exclusive ownership of the same shared files (glue.rs, script.ts) — this ticket is opened separately to avoid collision with that in-flight work.
summary: Refactored the degenerate artifact standard subsets mechanism into real industry conformance vocabularies end to end. Mechanism: taxonomy.json subset shape vocabulary, io/component.rs SubsetId/run_subset_validation semantics, script.ts policy overhaul (schema-owning structural detection replacing the ✳️any string-filter, new policyStandardSubsetVocabularyBreaches rule, 85 per-standard 🔣️component.json manifests, plus an incidental fix to a pre-existing char-literal bug in the Rust comment/string stripper). Delivered 32 real spec-derived conformance subsets across pdf/step/ifc/svg/docx/xlsx/pptx/tiff/jpg/xml/json/zip via a 2-agent pilot wave plus a 10-agent parallel fan-out (Workflow), each with real hard/soft checks, SubsetValidator registration, and inline tests — plus a whole new ifc 2x3 standard built from scratch. Applied all glue.rs wiring centrally as orchestrator. Found and fixed 13 real bugs surfaced by the fan-out (PDF writer round-trip limitations, docx/xlsx typed-model-overwrites-OPC-on-encode, a relationship-type gap, jpg envelope mismatch, tiff empty-image fixture, an ifc2x3 fixture miscount) via scoped test verification, reaching 744/744 passing before two unrelated concurrent sessions' in-flight work (stl, norm) made a fresh full-suite run temporarily unavailable — documented in 📋️completion-summary.md with a recommendation to re-verify once those land.
